key_insight: OvAi Focus combines AI-based segmentation and morphology extraction to make gynecological ultrasound interpretation of ovaries and adnexal masses more objective and standardized.
clinical_relevance: By helping identify healthy ovarian structures and classify adnexal mass features, this framework could support more consistent ultrasound reporting in ovarian cancer assessment.
method: Segmented healthy ovaries and adnexal mass components, including solid and cystic regions.
Extracted IOTA-based morphological keywords from ultrasound images.
Compared outputs against ground truth masks and interobserver agreement metrics.
evidence_signal: Segmentation DICE scores ranged from 0.62 for functional ovary to 0.87 for whole adnexal mass, while morphology agreement showed Fleiss kappa of 0.16 to 0.57 and percent agreement of 47% to 90%.
watch_item: Performance varied by structure and morphology task, so clinical use would require further validation, especially for lower-agreement features and real-world workflow integration.
paper_title: OvAi Focus: A framework for multiclass segmentation and morphological features extraction in gynecological ultrasound
